svg.aria-label: Harness firmware architecture with links: inputs feed a five-stage feedback loop, a stagnation supervisor intervenes conditionally, candidates pass a CI gate into an updated lineage that feeds lessons back into the firmware.
svg.title: Harness firmware architecture

g.text: 2 audit fails on one step → change approach
3 rounds, no new verified progress → rewrite plan

svg.text: lessons merge back into the firmware: kernel, skills, reference
